description: Sanity of the install itself. Nothing here is mod-specific: it is the set of things that must hold before any other checklist's result means anything.

checks.why: Every content check reads live world state. On the main menu they are all vacuous.
No main party usually means the save loaded into a broken state.

checks.what: The game is ticking, not hung
checks.why: A frozen main thread makes every other answer stale.

checks.what: Nothing has thrown an unhandled exception
checks.why: An unhandled exception means the process was on its way down.

checks.what: No structural data problems in the world
checks.why: Landless cultures and leaderless clans crash the engine days later, far from the cause.
